purpose: Establish the Identity & Access provisioning boundary required by all center operations.
success_outcome: A valid one-time invitation binds exactly its pre-created role-bearing account, while invalid or reused invitations leave account, role, membership, and binding state unchanged.
anti_goals: Do not accept client role selection.
Do not let Center & Scheduling or routes write identity-owned state directly.
constraints: Server-side role and center authorization is decisive.
invariants: Identity & Access exclusively writes account, role, invitation, external identity, and session state.
No partial binding remains after rejection.
verification_targets: FT-001-AC-003: expired, revoked, reused, and duplicate-identity rejection with state-before/state-after persistence comparison.

stop_conditions: Stop and route to /spec-design if the accepted Account Provisioning Boundary must change.
